author: Matt Larkin

Mortal Shell 2 opens with a beleaguered warrior trudging through various desolate landscapes that make plain the game’s Dark Souls DNA. In fact, it might have looked like an opening cinematic for Dark Souls—if not for the mysterious giant egg on the knight’s back.
